set.audit_note: Tier 4 spot check November 8, 2026: plan confirms 20% very low plus 10% low or 25% very low, permanent rental affordability, 25% density bonus, 10% low income for-sale (at least 10 years, reset on resale), City-initiated in-lieu fee only for detached for-sale projects under 50 units, and $1,100 Off-Site Affordable Housing Fee (cap $1,300) collected before final map. The stated for-sale exemption under 10 units was not found in the plan text (the attached ordinance applies the rental requirement to projects of 10 or more units). Prevailing wage false is uncited; this is a regulatory requirement with no public funds.

reason: Percentages, AMI tiers, density bonus and fee amounts match the Spring Lake Affordable Housing Plan.
